description: Carnot-based efficiency with ammonia fraction, condenser T correction, and part-load penalty

unit.name: Kalina KCS 34 geothermal/waste-heat unit (100 kW class)
unit.source: Bombarda et al. (2010), Appl. Thermal Eng. 30(2); Lolos & Rogdakis (2009), Energy 34(4)

x_NH3_design.note: Design ammonia mass fraction (optimal for 150C source)

eta_internal.note: Fraction of Carnot achieved (higher than ORC due to composition matching)

k_x.note: Efficiency sensitivity to NH3 fraction: f_x = 1 + k_x*(x - x_design)

k_T.note: Condenser T sensitivity: f_T = 1 - k_T*(T_cond - T_design). NH3 high dP/dT
